senses.gloss:
Vaikhānasa is the name of a mythical group of Ṛṣis who are
said in the Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa^1 to have been slain at Muni-
maraṇa by Rahasyu Devamalimluc, and who are mentioned
in the Taittirīya Āraṇyaka also.^2 An individual Vaikhānasa is
Puruhanman.^3
1) xiv. 4, 7.
2) i. 23, 3 (Indische Studien, 1, 78).
3) xiv. 9, 29.
